problem_text:
A municipality aims to devise a strategy for curbing nutrient runoff into a watershed from several agricultural drainage points. Initially, no mitigation practices are in place.  
The characteristics of each drainage point are as follows:  
* For Field A, runoff coefficient is 0.652, cultivated area is 68.373.  
* For Field B, runoff coefficient is 1.697, cultivated area is 70.198.  
* For Field C, runoff coefficient is 1.504, cultivated area is 202.074.  
* For Field D, runoff coefficient is 2.215, cultivated area is 66.421.  
* For Field E, runoff coefficient is 1.726, cultivated area is 118.754.  
* For Field F, runoff coefficient is 2.774, cultivated area is 208.269.  

To reduce nutrient loads, several best management practices (BMPs) are available, each with a specific efficacy in reducing runoff:  
* Implementing Practice1 reduces nutrient runoff by 46%  
* Implementing Practice2 reduces nutrient runoff by 64%  
* Implementing Practice3 reduces nutrient runoff by 10%  
* Implementing Practice4 reduces nutrient runoff by 48%  
* Implementing Practice5 reduces nutrient runoff by 54%  
* Implementing Practice6 reduces nutrient runoff by 42%  

Adopting a BMP at a drainage point incurs an implementation cost per unit of cultivated area. The cost matrix for all field–practice combinations is provided below:  
| Field \ Practice | Practice1 | Practice2 | Practice3 | Practice4 | Practice5 | Practice6 |  
|--|-|-|-|-|-|-|  
| Field A | 28.844 | 143.338 | 172.031 | 133.674 | 156.103 | 146.96 |  
| Field B | 50.854 | 95.795 | 53.414 | 74.397 | 96.165 | 89.038 |  
| Field C | 28.066 | 91.085 | 136.37 | 81.117 | 39.001 | 185.367 |  
| Field D | 22.755 | 168.037 | 27.714 | 28.347 | 150.371 | 164.236 |  
| Field E | 115.71 | 121.428 | 116.701 | 72.633 | 33.224 | 77.184 |  
| Field F | 136.415 | 152.554 | 174.938 | 147.002 | 193.996 | 124.078 |  

The decision involves selecting which BMPs to apply to each drainage point (multiple practices may be applied simultaneously to a single field), and it is permissible for a field to remain partially untreated if needed.  
The objective is to guarantee that the total nutrient runoff is diminished by at least a fraction P = 0.376 of the baseline load, while minimizing the aggregate implementation expenditure.
